newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Austereo says poised for growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Austereo says poised for growth.

text.p: Radio broadcaster Austereo Ltd said it is poised for further growth as its two main radio networks Triple M and Today Networks continue to win auidences.
Austereo, which is 53 percent owned Village Roadshow Ltd , earlier reported a near doubling of net profit to A$36.46 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
"Austereo is poised for further growth as both networks continue to win auidences," chairman John Kirby said in a statement.
It said advertising revenue rose 25 percent to a record A$139.1 million in 1995/96.
